# A slot's render that raises draws again on the next write. The render of
# the `for` reads labels(n), which raises at 1; the click whose write asked
# for that render holds a call that may raise, so its catch block takes the
# raise. The render's re-entry guard (__renderingN) was cleared after the
# loop, which the raise skipped, so every later render was taken for a
# re-entry and the list stayed as the raise left it. It is cleared in a
# finally now (ir.If.Finally, lower's renderOnce).
#
# Not asserted: whether the boundary's @error saw the raise. A render runs
# inside the handler that asked for it on html, fyne, gtk4 and android, and
# after it on the interpreter and bubbletea, where the boundary is not told.
#
# Not run on android: Compose has no render slot to guard, and a raise while
# it composes reaches no catch block at all -- the test ends there, with or
# without this fix, which is a gap of its own.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +1 tests, 0 failures$'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func labels(n int) list[string] {
    if n == 1 {
        error.raise("one is refused", "bad")
    }
    return ["n{n}"]
}

func check(n int) {
    if n > 100 {
        error.raise("too many", "bad")
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var n = 0
    var caught = ""
    boundary(@error(e) {
        caught = e.message
    }) {
        ui.button #step(text="step", @click {
            n += 1
            check(n)
        })
        for var l = labels(n) {
            ui.text #shown(value=l)
        }
    }
}

func testARenderDrawsAgainAfterARaise(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.shown[0] != null && c.shown[0].value == "n0")
    c.step.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 1)
    c.step.click()
    t.assert(c.shown[0] != null && c.shown[0].value == "n2")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
